data.name: Anastos
data.gender_notes: Anastos is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'anastasis', meaning resurrection. In Christian tradition, Anastos represents the divine power of life, renewal, and rebirth. The name Anastos carries the meaning “Resurrection” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Anastos usually hope their child will grow to embody resurrection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes hope and new beginnings, reminding us of the power of the resurrection and the promise of eternal life.
data.etymology: Anastos belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Resurrection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anastos total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Anastos carries a strong cultural connection to ancient Greece and the early Christian faith. In Greek mythology, Anastasis was the goddess of resurrection. This ancient association is a constant reminder of the enduring belief in life's renewal and the power of rebirth. As a Christian name, Anastos also represents the resurrection of Jesus Christ and the hope and promise of eternal life.
data.spiritual_significance: Anastos is a deeply spiritual name rooted in the principles of the Christian faith. It calls to mind the resurrection of Jesus Christ and the transformative power of divine grace. For those bearing this name, it serves as a reminder of their connection to the sacred promise of eternal life and the power to rise above adversity, pain, and suffering. Additionally, the name Anastos conveys hope and a commitment to new beginnings and the possibility of growth and transformation.
